test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 3, 12 and 12 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do twice the same work, working together?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Let total work = LCM(3, 12, 12) = 12 units. Total efficiency of (A + B + C) = (12 ÷ 3) + (12 ÷ 12) + (12 ÷ 12) = 4 + 1 + 1 = 6 units/day. Time taken to complete the normal work = 12 ÷ 6 = 2 days. Time taken to complete twice the work = 2 × 2 = 4 days. **∴ The correct answer is 4 days.**
